name: Poochyena

attacks.name: Team Hunt
attacks.text: Draw a card for each Poochyena you have in play.

flavor:
Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the
prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But
sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

pokedex.text: NO. 0261 Bite Pokémon HT: 1'8" WT: 30 lbs.
